name: 2100 Calumet Avenue — Brick dwelling (district draft; refined by T-1946)

function.note: The 1911 sheet marks the building 'D' (dwelling): '3B brick dwelling (D) on the 21st Street corner, a one-storey frame porch along its north side and its Calumet front, a 2B south piece with a rounded east end, a 1B piece behind it and a one-storey frame piece at its west end'. research_note: A DISTRICT DRAFT (T-3018, the owner's district pass of 2026-10-08): a serviceable first model, complete from the street, the walks, the alley and the air, that T-1946 refines in place under this same id. Written by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py from the sheet 35e trace (s35efp-calumet_2100-b1), the T-3018 census (s35e-2100-front) and the T-1837 register row frontage-35e-2100 (Brick dwelling); every height, roof, opening and feature is the draft rules' reconstruction (data/components/prairie_1904/draft_prairie_1904.json; liberty L-draft-district-background-3018).

documented_range.note: The draft claims the 1904 target and no more: the 1911 sheet draws the building and the T-3018 census rules it present in 1904 (present_as_mapped). Its building and loss dates are the per-building ticket's to read.

position.note: The rear corner of the main body's rectangle (lot frame u 29.250, v -2.500 m from the middle of the rear lot line), through the T-1250 fit of the sheet: the sheet's georeference carries no independent check: its own fit residual is 0.05 m RMS on its control crossings, a similarity on two degrees of freedom that says little away from them, plus about a pixel (0.19 m) of trace on this coarser copy. Rotation -0.609 degrees turns the plan's u axis onto the lot's own rear-to-street line.
